title: Dynamics 365 Business Central – Error Message “You have one or more documents that must be posted before you post document no….” when posting a Journal
summary: When posting a journal in Business Central, an error occurs if the journal's number series has manual numbers disabled but the user tries to enter a custom document number. The post explains three solutions: enable manual numbers on the number series, remove the number series from the batch, or use the renumber function to auto-generate the next sequential number.
key_points: The error happens when a journal batch is assigned a number series with manual numbers disabled, preventing users from entering custom document numbers
Manual numbers setting on the number series controls whether users can enter their own document numbers in journal batches using that series
Three solutions exist: enable manual numbers, remove the number series from the batch, or use the renumber document numbers function
The renumber function automatically fetches the next sequential number from the series, ensuring proper journal numbering

quotes.text: You have one or more documents that must be posted before you post document no..
quotes.why_it_matters: This is the exact error message users encounter, helping them identify the posting validation issue
